verse.verse_1: Verily, We sent Nuh to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."
verse.verse_2: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,"
verse.verse_3: "That you should worship Allah, and have Taqwa of Him, and obey me,"
verse.verse_4: "He will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allah when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but know."
verse.verse_5: He said: O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day,
verse.verse_6: But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight.
verse.verse_7: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted, and magnified themselves in pride.
verse.verse_8: Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).
verse.verse_9: Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.
verse.verse_10: I said (to them): Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;
verse.verse_11: He will send rain to you Midrar,
verse.verse_12: And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.
verse.verse_13: What is the matter with you, that you do not hope for any Waqar from Allah
verse.verse_14: While He has created you (in) Atwar (stages).
verse.verse_15: See you not how Allah has created the seven heavens in tiers
verse.verse_16: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp
verse.verse_17: And Allah has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth
verse.verse_18: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth.
verse.verse_19: And Allah has made for you the earth a wide expanse.
verse.verse_20: That you may go about therein in broad roads.
verse.verse_21: Nuh said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss."
verse.verse_22: "And they have plotted a mighty plot."
verse.verse_23: "And they have said: `You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa`, nor Yaghuth, and Ya`uq and Nasr.' "
verse.verse_24: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): `Grant no increase to the wrongdoers save error."'
verse.verse_25: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allah.
verse.verse_26: And Nuh said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth Dayyar!"
verse.verse_27: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers."
verse.verse_28: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the wrongdoers grant You no increase but destruction!") Allah says,
